caption_L1: This area diagram is called Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation disbursements on global health from 1999 to 2013 (in million U.S dollars). Year is drawn along the x-axis. A linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 2,000 can be seen on the y-axis, labeled Disbursements in million U.S. dollars.
caption_L2L3: Starting in 1999 at around 2.5 million U.S. dollars, apart from dropping in 2003 and 2009, the Foundation's  disbursements have grown each year.  Between 2004 and 2008 saw the highest growth where it rose from 600 million U.S. dollars to almost 2,000 million U.S. dollars.  By 2013 it stood at almost 2,000 million U.S. dollars.
